primary.poolable_reason: ONE TRIAL HAS NO CONTROL ARM AND ITS PRIMARY OUTCOME IS GROWTH. NCT00303459 is bosentan added to sildenafil against sildenafil alone in adults with pulmonary arterial hypertension, registered primary 'Time to First Confirmed Morbidity/Mortality Event'. NCT00319020 is a PAEDIATRIC EXTENSION STUDY with a single EXPERIMENTAL arm and no comparator, whose registered primaries are 'Change From Baseline to End of Study in HEIGHT FOR AGE' and 'Change From Baseline to End of Study in BODY WEIGHT'. A growth measurement in an uncontrolled extension cannot be averaged with a morbidity-mortality time-to-event endpoint; they are not the same kind of quantity, and one of them has nothing to be compared against.
